document.about: INSEE Informations rapides no. 270, unemployment in the third quarter of 2026 (Licence Ouverte). A ruled table on page 7 heads its columns Évolution depuis le T2 2026, the year set a narrow space after the quarter and cut from it by the grid.

notes: The table read its cells' text from their ink alone, dropping the page's space glyphs, and a space between two digits narrower than a digit gap was lost.

checks.issue: The column header read Évolution depuis le T22026.
As above: Évolution cumulée depuis le T42024.
